cards.title: Managing international flights with multiple children
cards.body: A parent traveling with four children experienced unexpected kindness from fellow passengers during an international flight. Small gestures like tucking in a sleeping child can make overwhelming travel situations feel manageable.

cards.title: Should you tell children what's in your will?
cards.body: Parents face the decision of whether to reveal inheritance plans to their children before death. Financial surprises in wills can sometimes create family conflict that advance communication might prevent.

cards.title: The emotional journey when your child leaves home
cards.body: Parents often experience mixed emotions when sending children to university, balancing sadness with excitement about newfound freedom. Recognizing these complicated feelings as normal helps navigate this major life transition.

cards.title: Family mealtimes strengthen parent-child connections
cards.body: Eating together creates valuable pauses in the day for parents and children to listen and share stories. Regular mealtimes build the foundation for meaningful family relationships and communication.

cards.title: Building moral purpose through challenge in boys
cards.body: Boys can discover self-worth through meaningful challenge and helping others rather than traditional metrics. Responsibility and contribution create belonging, confidence, and a strong moral foundation.

cards.title: Grandparents provide crucial multi-generational family support
cards.body: Grandparents offer significant practical and emotional support to families across generations. This arrangement benefits grandparents, parents, and children through shared responsibilities and strengthened bonds.

cards.title: Modeling healthy anger responses to your children
cards.body: Parents need to model that anger is a normal, acceptable emotion rather than something to hide. Children benefit from seeing adults acknowledge and process emotions authentically rather than suppress them.

cards.title: Supporting non-genetic parents in donor conception
cards.body: Couples using donor conception often underestimate the emotional challenges for the non-genetic parent. Practical strategies and open communication help address feelings of disconnection or exclusion.

cards.title: New vocational GCSE subjects including child development
cards.body: UK schools are introducing vocational GCSE options such as child development and construction. These courses provide practical alternatives to traditional academic subjects for diverse student interests.

cards.title: Measles prevention through door-to-door vaccination outreach
cards.body: Health officials in Pennsylvania are conducting home visits to increase measles vaccination rates after several deaths. Personal outreach helps address vaccine hesitancy in communities with low immunization coverage.
